beats.say: Your next Call of Duty match is about to feel very different.
Infinity Ward has been making Call of Duty games since the beginning, and they are finally back.
According to IGN, it has been four years since the studio shipped its last game, Modern Warfare 2.
Now, the Modern Warfare 4 beta is introducing a major change to how you find opponents.
IGN says the beta will utilise a new matchmaking system that first appeared in Black Ops 7 this July.
This means your favourite multiplayer modes will use the latest tech to balance your lobbies.
With the developers at Infinity Ward leading the way, the wait for the next era is almost over.
Are you ready for a new way to play? Your next match is about to feel very different.
